anh.noi_dung: Kunai luyện tập (mẫu server id 4 'Kunai cùn dùng để tập ném'): kunai cùn đặt chéo lấp ô vuông, lưỡi sắt xám xỉn mũi tròn có vết xước, chuôi quấn vải be sờn, khuyên tròn đuôi chuôi, thẻ da nâu nhỏ buộc chỉ cam. TÊN MỚI — bản `vk_kunai_thuong` 96×48 không vừa ô túi vuông 64×64.
anh.prompt_day_du: detailed 2D game sprite, hand-painted with cel-shading, clean dark outlines, rich shading (40+ colors), Naruto ninja aesthetic, NO flat vector shapes, NO background scenery, NO drop shadow on ground. ITEM ICON RULES: a single inventory item icon for a 2D Naruto-style RPG, 3/4 top-down view, the object floats centered and fills about 80% of a square canvas, no hands, no character, no table or shelf, light from the upper left, bold readable silhouette because the icon is shown at only 16x16 px in-game, no text, no watermark. SUBJECT: a single blunt training kunai (a practice throwing knife) lying diagonally from the lower-left to the upper-right so it fills the square. DETAILS: dull grey iron blade with a deliberately rounded, blunt tip and small scuff marks instead of a sharp edge highlight; grip wrapped in worn beige cloth with one or two loose thread ends; a round metal ring at the pommel; a tiny brown leather practice tag tied to the ring with an orange thread. PALETTE: dull iron grey, worn beige cloth, brown leather, one small Leaf Village orange accent. CONSISTENCY: same painting style, outline weight and level of detail as the attached reference icons vk_kunai_thuong_x4.png (shape of a kunai) and vp_ao_t1_x4.png (icon style) from the existing set; unlike vk_kunai_thuong this one must fit a SQUARE canvas and look worn and blunt, not a shiny weapon. CANVAS: 1024x1024 px square (the project scales it to 64x64, then 48/32/16). BACKGROUND: fully transparent PNG with a real alpha channel; if the tool cannot output transparency, use ONE flat solid mid-grey RGB(128,128,128) with no gradient and no vignette so it can be keyed out cleanly. Do not draw: a shadow on the ground, background scenery, more than one item, hands or a body wearing the item, a glow halo around the edges, blurred or thin 1-px details, text, a sharp gleaming blade, blood, a second kunai.
anh.ghi_chu: Tên mới, cần nối cuối kich-thuoc-anh.json: 64×64. Quyết định vẽ bản vuông thay vì đệm vk_kunai_thuong (2:1 → mảnh 1–2 px ở x1).
